game-master.observedBeforeActionResult: Real SC1 Remastered ranked match on Fighting Spirit: ground units cross a diagonal stone bridge over water. At source890–897s the bridge edges and unit path remain visible. Game clock advances approximately one second per source second.
game-master.claimLimits: Visible artwork does not measure the hidden grid. The8x8 path-cell explanation comes from Patrick Wyatt. No claim that this alone explains every Dragoon issue. Final cut retains the full original frame, aspect, recorder facecam, source branding and game UI; source credit also remains in the description.
